title: Kessler Owner Rewards Points: Program Rules — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Program rules for Owner Rewards points on Service Accounts and Repair Orders.**

**In force.**
1. Points are credited when the repair order is paid in full.
2. A redemption is credited to the repair order as a rewards redemption credit.
3. The tier's enrollment bonus is credited once when an account opens at a tier that carries one; it is booked as a points-earned entry with no repair order, dated on the opening date.
4. Tiers whose points per dollar is 0 neither earn nor redeem points.

**Retired.** The following clauses are **no longer in force**; each has been superseded by the current basis for that subject:
- the earning clause, under which a repair order earned the tier's points per whole dollar of customer-pay labor and parts actually paid, cents dropped, up to the tier's most points per repair order, with shop fees, late fees and deductibles earning nothing and, where covered lines do not earn, no work paid by a warranty, a recall, a service contract, a maintenance plan or goodwill earning points;
- the redemption clause, under which points were redeemed in whole points of at least the tier's fewest points per redemption, each worth the tier's point value, paying at most the tier's largest redemption share of the repair order's customer-pay labor and parts total, with the tier labor and parts discounts applied first and points paying part of what remains;
- the expiry clause, under which points expired at the end of the calendar month falling the tier's expiry period after the month they were earned, oldest points used first.

**Reading the clauses in force.**
| Situation | Clause in force | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| A repair order is not yet paid in full | 1 | No points are credited for it |
| Points are redeemed toward a repair order | 2 | A rewards redemption credit stands on that repair order |
| An account opens at a tier whose enrollment bonus is above 0 | 3 | One enrollment bonus entry, once |
| The account is at a tier whose points per dollar is 0 | 4 | No points are earned or redeemed |

superseded_clauses: A repair order earns points_earn_per_usd points per whole dollar of customer-pay labor and parts actually paid (service_msr_ro_customer_pay_total, cents dropped), up to max_points_per_ro per repair order; shop fees, late fees and deductibles earn nothing, and where points_earn_on_covered_lines is false no work paid by warranty, recall, service contract, maintenance plan or goodwill earns points.

Points are redeemed in whole points of at least points_min_redemption, each worth points_value_usd, and may pay at most points_max_redemption_pct_of_ro of the repair order's customer-pay labor and parts total; the tier labor and parts discounts apply first and points pay part of what remains.
Points expire at the end of the calendar month that is points_expiry_months after the month they were earned, oldest points used first (service_msr_expiring_points).
